main.notes: All global settings. UTF-8 WITH BOM (EF BB BF) before the first line '[General]': a parser that does not strip the BOM sees the first section as '\ufeff[General]' (cocoonlib appconf.ini_read currently files [General] keys under '/'); keep the BOM when writing. 'Key = Value', bools True/False. Location comes from the memstick choice in /data/data/org.ppsspp.ppssppgold/files/memstick_dir.txt (a SAF tree URI such as <sdcard>:PPSSPP); the file sits on the SD card (owner media_rw, mode 770). Read once at app start (NativeInit -> Config::Load). Written from memory (load file, overwrite every known key, keep unknown lines) when leaving a settings screen, when a game exits, and in onDestroy (NativeShutdown). A force-stop skips the save.

controls.notes: [ControlMapping] button = <deviceId>-<keyCode>[,...] (10 = default pad). UTF-8 with BOM. Saved with the main config when not in a game.

per_game.game_id: PARAM.SFO DISC_ID without a dash, e.g. ULUS10051. Read it from PSP_GAME/PARAM.SFO inside the ISO; [PlayTime] in ppsspp.ini lists IDs of played games.
per_game.notes: Loaded at game boot only if the file exists (PSPLoaders -> Config::LoadGameConfig); every setting found in the file overrides the global value, missing keys keep the global value, so a hand-made file with a few lines works. Same section/key names as ppsspp.ini, plus [PostShaderList], [PostShaderSetting] and [ControlMapping] (per-game controls). When the game exits or its settings screen closes, PPSSPP rewrites the file with EVERY per-game setting at its current value (a full snapshot), so later global changes no longer reach that game for those keys. While in game-specific mode the main ppsspp.ini save skips PER_GAME keys. Created empty by Game info > Create game config, then filled on save. Delete the file to return the game to global settings. Edit only while the app is stopped, or at least while that game is not running.

graphics_backend.label: Settings > Graphics > Backend
graphics_backend.notes: Written as '<int> (<NAME>)'; on read the leading integer wins, and plain 3, VULKAN, 0 or OPENGL also parse. Android default is Vulkan when the driver supports it. Takes effect on app restart. Global only: not a PER_GAME setting, and the app never writes it to a game ini.

internal_resolution.label: Settings > Graphics > Rendering Resolution
internal_resolution.notes: 1x PSP = 480x272. Default on Android is 2 when the longest display side is >= 1000 px, else 1. Per-game: same [Graphics] InternalResolution line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

display_resolution.label: Settings > Graphics > Display Resolution (HW scaler)
display_resolution.notes: Android only. Global only: not a PER_GAME setting, and the app never writes it to a game ini.

software_rendering.label: Settings > Graphics > Software Rendering (slow)
software_rendering.notes: Per-game: same [Graphics] SoftwareRenderer line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

msaa.label: Settings > Graphics > Antialiasing (MSAA)
msaa.notes: Samples = 1 << value. Shown in the UI only when the driver reports MSAA support; do not write levels the GPU lacks. Per-game: same [Graphics] MultiSampleLevel line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

vsync.label: Settings > Graphics > VSync
vsync.notes: Current key is VerticalSync. A [Graphics] VSync line left by older versions is a stale key and is ignored. Per-game: same [Graphics] VerticalSync line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

low_latency_display.label: Settings > Graphics > Low latency display
low_latency_display.notes: Per-game: same [Graphics] LowLatencyPresent line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

frameskip.label: Settings > Graphics > Frame Skipping
frameskip.notes: Frames skipped per rendered frame. The UI disables it while AutoFrameSkip is on. Per-game: same [Graphics] FrameSkip line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

auto_frameskip.label: Settings > Graphics > Auto FrameSkip
auto_frameskip.notes: Turning it on in the UI also turns off SkipBufferEffects (Config::UpdateAfterSettingAutoFrameSkip); do the same when writing. Per-game: same [Graphics] AutoFrameSkip line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

alt_speed.label: Settings > Graphics > Alternative Speed
alt_speed.notes: Stored as a frame rate, not a percent: FrameRate = percent * 60 / 100 (UI 200% = 120, 50% = 30). 0 = unlimited, -1 = disabled. Used while the alternative-speed hotkey is held or toggled. Per-game: same [Graphics] FrameRate line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

alt_speed_2.label: Settings > Graphics > Alternative Speed 2
alt_speed_2.notes: Same encoding as alt_speed. Per-game: same [Graphics] FrameRate2 line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

skip_buffer_effects.label: Settings > Graphics > Skip Buffer Effects
skip_buffer_effects.notes: Speed hack; breaks many post-effects. Per-game: same [Graphics] SkipBufferEffects line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

skip_gpu_readbacks.label: Settings > Graphics > Skip GPU Readbacks
skip_gpu_readbacks.notes: Per-game: same [Graphics] SkipGPUReadbackMode line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

lens_flare_occlusion.label: Settings > Graphics > Lens flare occlusion
lens_flare_occlusion.notes: Enum DepthRasterMode {DEFAULT, LOW_QUALITY, OFF, FORCE_ON}; Android default is 1 (Low). Per-game: same [Graphics] DepthRasterMode line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

bloom_hack.label: Settings > Graphics > Lower resolution for effects
bloom_hack.notes: Per-game: same [Graphics] BloomHack line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

render_duplicate_frames.label: Settings > Graphics > Render duplicate frames to 60hz
render_duplicate_frames.notes: Smoother frame pacing in 30 fps games. Per-game: same [Graphics] RenderDuplicateFrames line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

inflight_frames.label: Settings > Graphics > Buffer graphics commands
inflight_frames.notes: Lower = less input latency, may cost speed. Global only: not a PER_GAME setting, and the app never writes it to a game ini.

hardware_transform.label: Settings > Graphics > Hardware Transform
hardware_transform.notes: Per-game: same [Graphics] HardwareTransform line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

software_skinning.label: Settings > Graphics > Software Skinning
software_skinning.notes: Per-game: same [Graphics] SoftwareSkinning line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

texture_shader.label: Settings > Graphics > GPU texture upscaler (fast)
texture_shader.notes: Vulkan only. Names are the [sections] of assets/shaders/defaultshaders.ini with Type=Texture. The UI also sets Graphics/TexHardwareScaling = (TextureShader != Off); the texture cache only applies the shader when TexHardwareScaling is True, so write both. Per-game: same [Graphics] TextureShader line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

tex_hardware_scaling.label: (set by the GPU texture upscaler choice)
tex_hardware_scaling.notes: Must be True for texture_shader to apply. Per-game: same [Graphics] TexHardwareScaling line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

tex_scaling_type.label: Settings > Graphics > CPU texture upscaler (slow)
tex_scaling_type.notes: Per-game: same [Graphics] TexScalingType line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

tex_scaling_level.label: Settings > Graphics > Upscale Level
tex_scaling_level.notes: CPU upscaler factor. Mobile builds offer Off/2x/3x (desktop also 4x, 5x). Per-game: same [Graphics] TexScalingLevel line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

anisotropy.label: Settings > Graphics > Anisotropic Filtering
anisotropy.notes: Per-game: same [Graphics] AnisotropyLevel line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

texture_filter.label: Settings > Graphics > Texture Filter
texture_filter.notes: Per-game: same [Graphics] TextureFiltering line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

smart_2d_filtering.label: Settings > Graphics > Smart 2D texture filtering
smart_2d_filtering.notes: Per-game: same [Graphics] Smart2DTexFiltering line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

replace_textures.label: Settings > Graphics > Replace textures
replace_textures.notes: Loads texture packs from PSP/TEXTURES/<GAMEID>/. Per-game: same [Graphics] ReplaceTextures line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

status_overlay.label: Settings > Graphics > Show FPS Counter / Show Speed / Show Battery %
status_overlay.notes: Bit mask: 2 = FPS counter, 4 = speed, 8 = battery percent (enum ShowStatusFlags). Add the bits. Per-game: same [Graphics] iShowStatusFlags line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

post_shader.label: Display layout & effects > Postprocessing shaders
post_shader.notes: Chain: [PostShaderList] PostShader1, PostShader2, ... (Off entries are dropped). Shader parameters go in [PostShaderSetting] as <ShaderName>SettingCurrentValue<N> = float. The section is rewritten (cleared) on every save. Names are defaultshaders.ini sections (assets/shaders) plus any user shaders in PSP/shaders. Per-game: same [PostShaderList] PostShader1 line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

screen_filter.label: Display layout & effects > Screen Scaling Filter
screen_filter.notes: 1.20 keeps display layout per orientation in [DisplayLayout.Landscape] / [DisplayLayout.Portrait]. The same key in [Graphics] is the pre-1.19 location and is only read when [DisplayLayout.Landscape] is missing. Per-game: same [DisplayLayout.Landscape] BufferFiltering line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

stretch.label: Display layout & effects > Stretch
stretch.notes: Per-game: same [DisplayLayout.Landscape] DisplayStretch line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

integer_scale.label: Display layout & effects > Integer scale factor
integer_scale.notes: Per-game: same [DisplayLayout.Landscape] DisplayIntegerScale line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

aspect_ratio.label: Display layout & effects > Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.notes: Multiplier on the PSP's 480:272 shape, slider 0.1-2.0. Written with 6 decimals. Ignored when Stretch or Integer scale is on. Per-game: same [DisplayLayout.Landscape] DisplayAspectRatio line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

crop_to_16x9.label: (no UI in 1.20.4; ini only)
crop_to_16x9.notes: Crops 480x272 to exact 16:9 when the image fills a 16:9 screen at scale 1, aspect 1 and centred offsets (PresentationCommon.cpp). Per-game: same [Graphics] DisplayCropTo16x9 line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

cpu_core.label: Developer tools > CPU Core
cpu_core.notes: Enum CPUCore. Default JIT (1) where JIT is allowed. Per-game: same [CPU] CPUCore line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

cpu_clock.label: Settings > System > Change CPU Clock (unstable)
cpu_clock.notes: Emulated PSP CPU MHz, 0-1000. Some games run smoother at 333; higher can break games. Per-game: same [CPU] CPUSpeed line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

fast_memory.label: Settings > System > Fast Memory
fast_memory.notes: Per-game: same [CPU] FastMemoryAccess line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

sound.label: Settings > Audio > Enable Sound
sound.notes: Per-game: same [Sound] Enable line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

game_volume.label: Settings > Audio > Game volume
game_volume.notes: 0-100. Per-game: same [Sound] GameVolume line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.

audio_playback_mode.label: Settings > Audio > Playback mode
audio_playback_mode.notes: Enum AudioSyncMode {GRANULAR, CLASSIC_PITCH}. Global only: not a PER_GAME setting, and the app never writes it to a game ini.

framerate_mode.label: Developer tools > Framerate mode
framerate_mode.notes: Android display refresh-rate request (enum DisplayFramerateMode). Global only: not a PER_GAME setting, and the app never writes it to a game ini.

auto_load_save_state.label: Settings > System > Auto load savestate
auto_load_save_state.notes: UI choices: 0 Off, 1 Oldest Save (shown only when already set), 2 Newest Save, 3-7 = Slot 1-5. Per-game: same [General] AutoLoadSaveState line in PSP/SYSTEM/<GAMEID>_ppsspp.ini.
